summary: Record native harness questions as system-only claims holding ids and option positions, never text; retain compact ended records and receipts indefinitely

replay.detail: No replay. No existing claim carries the new kinds. Checkpoint proofs compare the compact question before and after trimming redundant observation history.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema version change. The claim schema registry gains the harness-question subject family and the system-only kinds harness-question.observed and harness-question.resolved.

rules.detail: Rules version 18 follows #1473's allocated version 17 and main's review-reader version 16. Whichever PR lands second must renumber in a plain follow-up commit. Pending question history stays whole; one day after resolution redundant older observations may expire. The newest observation, resolution, positions and receipt stay indefinitely. Members seal and verify new checkpoints only when every participant runs rules 18. Replication and ordinary work are unaffected while rules differ.

compatibility.detail: Replication-compatibility event: the claim schema registry digest changes because it gains the harness-question family and its two kinds, so the replication schema digest changes and the existing registry upgrade rules apply. A member on an older build rejects the new kinds at schema admission and keeps them as unknown records until it is upgraded. Nothing writes the new kinds until a harness adapter adopts them; no client action, CLI command or wire field changes in this release.

downtime.detail: No restart requirement beyond the ordinary deploy and no startup work.

manual.detail: Deploy every checkpoint participant to rules 18 together; until then new checkpoints wait at sealing.

recovery.detail: Compact ended records never expire or resurrect as pending on re-observation. Rolling back to rules 16 stalls new checkpoints until the member runs rules 18 again; older registries retain harness-question claims as unknown records until upgraded.
